description: This Java class provides static methods to generate test data for a book-related application, including authors, books, publishers, tags, and shelves, mainly used for testing or populating the application with sample data.

classes.name: TestData
classes.description: Utility class for generating sample data related to books, authors, publishers, tags, and shelves for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateRandomNumberInRange
methods.description: Generates a random integer between 300 and 1000 inclusive.

methods.name: generateAuthors
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined Author objects with common author names.

methods.name: generateBooks
methods.description: Creates a list of Book objects with various titles, associating them with authors, tags, predefined shelves, and publishers.

methods.name: generatePublishers
methods.description: Creates a list of Publisher objects with fixed publisher names.

methods.name: generateListOfTags
methods.description: Creates a list of Tag objects with specific tag names.

methods.name: createBook
methods.description: Constructs a Book object with randomly assigned author, genre, shelf, publisher, and other metadata.

methods.name: setPredefinedShelfForBooks
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to a list of books, setting reading/done dates and ratings accordingly.
